selected.problemZh: 内容Mod反复接触原生升级/服务对象，容易把已介绍、已解锁、实际生效或付款混为一谈。
selected.problemEn: Mods otherwise repeat native progression lookups and confuse introduced, unlocked, active and paid states.
selected.behavior: Current-run managed snapshots from exact native predicates; no purchase/unlock/cost update.

selected.problemZh: 机器、对话、工坊和事件各写一套前置判断，未知状态取反会错误放行，JSON和C#规则也容易不一致。
selected.problemEn: Machines, dialogue, workshops and events duplicate gates; negating unknown facts can incorrectly allow actions.
selected.behavior: Shared strict C#/JSON bounded condition tree and three-valued evaluation; typed bilingual reasons; actual current-run fact adapter.

selected.problemZh: 每个物品升级Mod重复处理标签、损坏JSON、版本迁移和交易冻结。
selected.problemEn: Item upgrades otherwise duplicate tag ownership, malformed JSON, migration and freeze checks.
selected.behavior: Official versioned item JSON; compare revision, bounded data, native freeze, readback and graph restoration checked; no auto-save. Explicit native save and new-process restoration verified on five namespaced endpoint fixture items; Stage never saves.
